creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since 2026-10-05 the daemon walks past Codex's helper processes (codex-linux-sandbox etc., named from the 0.154.0 binary's strings, not observed on Linux). Run report --waiting from Codex's shell under the workspace-write sandbox on a devenv: the daemon log should have no daemon.report.foreign_agent, and muster window should show the pane waiting. If refused, the log names the process; its argv[0] is the name to add to codex.toml helpers.
title: Check on a Linux devenv that a Codex agent's own report --waiting is taken
